name: m4-selftype-11312-bootstrapped
description: Does [scala/scala#11312](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11312) add anything on top of the class-based analyzer ([scala/scala#11367](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11367)) once the compiler is built by a compiler with the change? The integration figure (-0.2%) came from a STARR without it, so it measured only `selfTypeClass` running.

Each checkout is compiled by a STARR built from its own tree, published as 2.13.80 and 2.13.81 and copied to the worker's `~/.ivy2/local`. A local build of the two shows 1454 fewer `invokeinterface` in compiler and reflect with the change. Full compile of the scala corpus, one `Global`, release optimizer settings, patched JDK 26.

variantDescriptions.class: #11367 + its test fix (`c70d28b4dd`), compiled by its own STARR, 2.13.80
variantDescriptions.selftype: `class` merged with #11312 at `6d62e6927b` (`b295320942`), compiled by its own STARR, 2.13.81
